# Lisbon 4-Day Trip Plan for 2 Adults
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg

A relaxed Lisbon plan centered on museums, local food, and scenic neighborhoods, with walking and public transit as the main way around. I’ve kept each day to no more than 2 major activities and aimed to stay within your **$1,800 total budget excluding flights**.

# Day-by-Day Itinerary and Budget
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and Alfama first look
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and do an easy walk through Baixa and Chiado.
- Afternoon: Visit the Lisbon Cathedral area and wander Alfama’s viewpoints and lanes.
- Food: Casual dinner with bacalhau or grilled sardines in Alfama.
- Estimated cost for 2: **$220**
  - Transit: $12
  - Food: $90
  - Coffee/snacks: $18
  - Activities: $20
  - Buffer: $80

Day 2: Museum day in Belém
- Morning: Visit the **MAAT** or **National Coach Museum**.
- Afternoon: Slow walk through Belém, with a stop at Jerónimos area and riverside views.
- Food: Pastéis de Belém plus a sit-down lunch nearby.
- Estimated cost for 2: **$260**
  - Transit: $14
  - Food: $110
  - Museum entries: $40
  - Pastries/coffee: $16
  - Buffer: $80

Day 3: Scenic neighborhoods and relaxed half-day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Ride public transit to **Graça** and **Miradouro da Senhora do Monte** for viewpoints.
- Afternoon: Keep it light with a long lunch and a slow neighborhood stroll in Mouraria or Graça.
- Food: Traditional tascas, petiscos, and a simple vinho verde stop.
- Estimated cost for 2: **$190**
  - Transit: $12
  - Food: $120
  - Drinks/snacks: $18
  - Buffer: $40

Day 4: Time Out Market and riverfront finish
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Easy start with a late breakfast and a final museum or shop stop in central Lisbon.
- Afternoon: Browse the riverfront or Time Out Market area for a last scenic walk and lunch.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/83/Lobster%2C_Time_Out_Market_Lisboa_%2850661858143%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Browse the riverfront or Time Out Market area for a last scenic walk and lunch, Lisbon, Portugal
- Food: Choose a few market dishes to share before departure.
- Estimated cost for 2: **$210**
  - Transit: $12
  - Food: $120
  - Snacks/coffee: $18
  - Buffer: $60

## Budget Fit for 2 Adults
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-dollar.svg

- Lodging: **$760** total for 4 nights at a mid-range hotel or apartment
- Food and drinks: **$460**
- Transit: **$50**
- Museums and entry fees: **$120**
- Local buffer for extras: **$210**
- Planned total: **$1,600**
- Remaining cushion: **$200**

## Simple Packing Checklist
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/suitcase.svg

- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light layers for cool mornings and mild afternoons
- Compact umbrella or light rain jacket
- Small day bag or crossbody bag
- Portable charger
- Reusable water bottle
- Sunglasses and sunscreen
- Travel documents and payment cards
- Phone with offline maps
- One slightly nicer outfit for dinner

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: View Lisbon transit] https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/
Action: [Button: Museum ideas] https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/lisbon/things-to-do/museums
Action: [Button: Belém area guide] https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/places/belem

## Sources
- Lisbon Metro official site: https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/
- Visit Lisboa official guide: https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/
- MAAT official site: https://www.maat.pt/en/
